name: contract-intelligence
description: Root package.json to trick Render's Node environment into building both frontend and backend

scripts.postinstall: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt --target ./pypackages --break-system-packages
scripts.start: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=./pypackages python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
